brief:
Human rights campaigners are calling on British authorities to launch an independent investigation into the United Kingdom's involvement in events in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The demand reflects growing pressure to address questions about potential British complicity in actions taken during the conflict.

Supporters of the inquiry argue that postponing such scrutiny will not resolve underlying questions about UK responsibility and accountability. The call signals continued public debate over the extent of British involvement and the need for official transparency on the matter.
dek: Delaying scrutiny will not make questions about UK complicity in Gaza disappear.
title: Activists demand UK inquiry into British role in Gaza conflict
